name: Self Murder
overview: Scripture affirms the sanctity of human life, declaring that God requires the life of man to be respected, as seen in Genesis 9:5 and the commandment 'Thou shalt not kill' in Exodus 20:13. While there are specific allowances for just actions, such as in Exodus 22:2, the gravity of taking life is clear. The account of Judas in Matthew 27:5, who ended his own life, serves as a somber example of the tragic consequences of despair. Together, these verses highlight the seriousness with which God views life and the solemn responsibility believers have to honor it.
